title: First-Touch SDK Credential Path: Illustration & Screenshot Pack
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a cohesive set of micro-illustrations, annotated screenshots, and motion-ready sprites that guide developers through the SDK credential flow (API key creation, local environment setup, streaming handshake, and tool-call example). Deliverables should be modular (cards, hero banner, inline step images, and 3 short looping GIFs) so the docs team can place them in quickstart pages, SDK README, and the Console 'Get Started' modal.
acceptance_criteria: New illustration set includes: 6 step cards (static SVGs) covering key creation, key rotation, environment variables, streaming connect, tool call auth handshake, and error surface
3 motion assets (short GIFs or Lottie-compatible exports) demonstrating streaming start, tool-call approval flow, and key rotation UX
Annotated screenshots for Console 'Create API Key' and SDK sample app with callouts for environment variables and token storage best practices
Assets exported in multiple sizes (64px, 128px, 320px hero) and themes (light/dark) with transparent backgrounds where appropriate
Figma file handed off with component variants and tokens; docs team has direct links to each export
Design review sign-off from PM (Sofia Ruiz) and Eng (Devon Chen) and UX accessibility pass (contrast and alt text notes)
